conventions: No restriction to polynomial, elementary or quasipolynomial growth of f. Randomized separation would be another premise.
definition: Some parameterized problem in W[1] has no deterministic fixed-parameter tractable decision algorithm.
model: Deterministic uniform algorithms on explicitly encoded inputs, under fixed-parameter reductions.
name: FPT ≠ W[1]
quantifiers: An FPT algorithm has time f(k) · L^C for a computable function f, a fixed constant C, parameter k, and complete input length L.
